name: Torek's Assault
summary: At Silverwing Outpost, Torek leads a strike against the night elves. Sent by Splintertree Post, the orc raider means to break Sentinel resistance and kill their commander, Duriel Moonfire, in Ashenvale's border war.

sections.title: A Strike from the Shadows
sections.body: Across Ashenvale, the Horde's lumber camps and the native night elves are locked in a growing border war. Torek gathers raiders from Splintertree just outside Silverwing Outpost, aiming to break the Alliance's defenses. He charges before the night elves can counterattack or gather strength for a reinforced campaign against Splintertree Post.

sections.title: Taking Silverwing
sections.body: Silverwing Outpost is a woodland garrison held by Silverwing Sentinels and fierce elven warriors. Torek sets his sights on their leader, Duriel Moonfire. If she falls, the local night elf command loses its head, and the raiders can report their bloody victory to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

faq.answer: Torek is an orc raider based at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Fierce and eager for battle, he leads a band against the night elf forces in the forest.
Silverwing Outpost is a fortified night elf settlement in Ashenvale. Elite Sentinels and warriors guard it, watching Horde movements along the woodland trails.
Duriel Moonfire commands the night elves defending Silverwing Outpost. She leads its Sentinels against Horde attacks until Torek's raiders break into the camp and strike her down.
Ertog Ragetusk is a Horde officer at Splintertree Post. He is Torek's superior, oversees military operations in the region, and receives reports of victories against the Alliance.

faq.q: Why does the Horde attack Silverwing Outpost?
faq.answer: The Horde and night elves are fighting over territory across Ashenvale. By striking Silverwing Outpost, the Horde eases pressure on its supply lines and weakens the Sentinel defenses guarding the deeper forest.

faq.q: Where does this attack take place?
faq.answer: The attack begins just outside Silverwing Outpost, on the Horde-held eastern side of the Falfarren River in Ashenvale. It ends inside the night elf encampment.

angles.text: For the Horde, breaking through Silverwing Outpost tests your strength and weakens the night elf blockade around Splintertree Post.
Duriel Moonfire's fall leaves Silverwing Outpost exposed and threatens the night elves' ancestral woodland holdings.
A brutal frontal battle tests your endurance against seasoned Sentinel archers and blademasters.
The raid strikes the Sentinels' frontline command, spilling elven blood beneath Ashenvale's boughs.
